commit_message: lavf: move demuxing-specific fields from FFFormatContext to FormatContextInternal
pr_title: lavf: move demuxing-specific fields from FFFormatContext to FormatContextInternal

findings.title: Muxer packet_buffer not freed due to overly broad iformat guard
findings.message: When demuxing-specific fields (parse_queue, raw_packet_buffer, raw_packet_buffer_size) were moved from FFFormatContext to FormatContextInternal, the call to ff_flush_packet_queue() in avformat_free_context() was guarded with 'if (s->iformat)' to prevent accessing demuxer-only fields on muxer contexts. However, ff_flush_packet_queue() also frees si->packet_buffer, which resides on FFFormatContext and is used by muxers (in mux.c via ff_interleave_add_packet). By guarding the entire ff_flush_packet_queue() call behind s->iformat, the muxer's packet_buffer is never freed when the format context is destroyed. If a muxing process fails while packets remain in the interleaving queue, those packets will leak.
findings.suggestion: Add an unconditional avpriv_packet_list_free(&si->packet_buffer) call before the guarded ff_flush_packet_queue() call. The iformat guard is correct for parse_queue and raw_packet_buffer (demuxer-only), but packet_buffer is shared by both muxers and demuxers and must be freed unconditionally.

ground_truth.root_cause: The commit cb80ec0b moved parse_queue, raw_packet_buffer, and raw_packet_buffer_size to FormatContextInternal (demuxer-only). To prevent invalid memory access on muxer contexts, the entire ff_flush_packet_queue() call was guarded behind 'if (s->iformat)'. However, ff_flush_packet_queue() also clears si->packet_buffer which lives on FFFormatContext (accessible for both muxers and demuxers). The overly broad guard prevents packet_buffer from being freed for muxers.
